items.title: 9.1 Mehfooz aur zimmedarana digital amal (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu of topic 9.1 (PDF 123-125), paragraph for paragraph; the password note, safe-habits figure, self-check and recap are ours.

blocks.text: Yeh hissa batata hai ke online kaam karte waqt technology ko samajhdari se kaise use karein aur apni zaati maloomat (personal information) ko kaise bachayein. Talaba mehfooz aadaton ki ahmiyat seekhte hain, jaise mazboot passwords rakhna, software ko update rakhna aur ghair-mehfooz websites se bachna (Figure 9.2 dekhein). Zimmedarana digital rawaiya data ke zaya hone, hacking aur identity theft (kisi ki pehchan chura kar use karna) se bachata hai. Safety ke qawaid par chal kar users bila wajah khatre ke baghair technology ke faide utha sakte hain. Yeh aadatein bharosa paida karti hain aur sab ke liye mehfooz digital mahol banati hain.

blocks.alt: Neeli shirt wala talib-e-ilm kursi par desk ke samne baith kar computer par keyboard chala raha hai. Gird teen nishan hain: baen taraf taala (padlock), upar do gol update ke teer, aur daen taraf tick wali dhaal (shield). Tasveer par koi label nahi.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.2: Mehfooz digital amal (safe digital practices) (kitab ki Figure 9.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki tasveer mein likha kuch nahi, sirf teen nishan hain. Taala (padlock) mazboot passwords ki alamat hai, gol teer software update rakhne ki, aur tick wali dhaal (shield) mehfooz rehne ki, yani khatarnak websites aur downloads se bachne ki. Yahi teen aadatein upar wale paragraph mein bayan hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: 12 characters wala mazboot password torne (crack karne) mein computer ko lakhon saal lag sakte hain, lekin kamzor password seconds mein toot sakta hai.
Online Safety ki ahmiyat

Online safety ka matlab hai internet use karte waqt apni aur apni maloomat ki hifazat karna. Is mein yeh shamil hai ke aap kya share karte hain, kahan click karte hain aur apna data kaise rakhte hain, in sab mein ehtiyat karein. Talaba seekhte hain ke online kaam digital footprints (online qadmon ke nishan) chhorte hain jinhein track kiya ja sakta hai. Safety ki ahmiyat samajh kar users scams (dhoke), viruses aur cyber threats (online khatron) se bach sakte hain. Online hoshyar aur mohtat rehne se zaati aur school se mutaliq dono tarah ka data mehfooz rehta hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Khatron aur un se bachao ke tareeqon (preventive measures) ko samajhna cybercrime ka imkaan kam karta hai.
Mazboot passwords aur data protection mein un ka kirdar

Mazboot password letters, numbers aur symbols ka aisa milap hai jo aap ke accounts ko hackers se bachata hai. Har account ka alag (unique) password rakhne se hack hone ka imkaan kam ho jata hai. Naam ya birthday jaisi zaati tafseel password mein na dalna behtar hai. Kitab kehti hai ke passwords baqaida badalte rahein aur kisi se share na karein. Mehfooz password online zaroori files aur data bachane ki pehli deewar (first line of defense) hai.

blocks.title: Kitab se aage (aam ilm)
blocks.text: Kitab baqaida passwords badalne ka mashwara deti hai. Aaj ki security rehnumai lambe, munfarid (unique) passwords pasand karti hai jo chori ke shak par foran badle jayein, two-factor authentication ke saath, kyunke zabardasti baar baar badalne se aksar log kamzor passwords bana lete hain.
Mashkook software download karne aur ghair-mehfooz browsing ke khatre

Na-maloom websites se programs ya files download karne se computer ko nuqsan ho sakta hai ya aap ki maloomat chori ho sakti hai. Kuch downloads mein viruses ya spyware (chupke se jasoosi karne wala software) chhupe hote hain jo ijazat ke baghair data jama karte hain. Ghair-mehfooz browsing, jaise jaali (fake) websites par jana ya na-maloom links par click karna, bhi scams ya identity theft tak le ja sakti hai. Download se pehle source check karna aur izafi hifazat ke liye antivirus tools use karna zaroori hai. Mehfooz browsing ki aadatein devices aur data dono ko mehfooz rakhti hain.
Software maintenance aur updates

Software maintenance (dekh-bhaal) ka matlab hai programs aur applications ko baqaida update kar ke achhi halat mein rakhna. Updates aksar errors theek karte hain, performance behtar karte hain aur naye features dalte hain jo software ko zyada mehfooz banate hain. Talaba seekhte hain ke software companies updates is liye jari karti hain ta ke woh security gaps (hifazat ke soorakh) band hon jin se hackers faida utha sakte hain. Updates nazarandaz karne se system slow ho sakta hai, crash ho sakta hai ya data chori ho sakta hai. Baqaida maintenance computers ko bharosemand, tez aur cyber threats se mehfooz rakhti hai.

Jab software update nahi hota to woh hackers ka aasan nishana ban jata hai. Purane versions mein aise security holes ho sakte hain jo files ya zaati data tak unauthorized access (be-ijazat rasai) dete hain. Purana (outdated) software naye systems ya tools ke saath compatibility (mel na khane) ke masle bhi paida kar sakta hai. Aise programs use karne se malware infection aur data breach (data leak hona) ka khatra barhta hai. Software ko baqaida update karna yeh khatre kam karta hai aur system ko mehfooz aur bharosemand rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Talaba updated aur outdated (purane) software ke features ka muwazna karein aur guftagu karein ke purane versions par hamla kaise ho sakta hai.
Privacy aur security settings

Privacy aur security settings users ko yeh control dene mein madad karti hain ke un ki zaati maloomat online kaise use aur share ho. Yeh settings zyada tar apps, websites aur digital platforms mein hoti hain. Talaba seekhte hain ke location, contacts aur browsing history jaisa zaati data bachane ke liye inhein kaise set karein. Privacy sambhalne se ghair-zaroori logon ya advertisers (ishtihar dene walon) ke hathon maloomat ka ghalat istemal rukta hai. Yeh settings samajh kar use karne se online sargarmiyan zyada private aur mehfooz rehti hain. Misal: Instagram par user apna account private kar sakta hai ta ke sirf approved followers us ki posts dekh sakein. Woh apni privacy ke liye location sharing band kar sakta hai aur account ki izafi hifazat ke liye two-factor authentication on kar sakta hai.
Privacy policies parhna aur sambhalna

Privacy policy batati hai ke website ya app aap ki maloomat kaise jama karti, rakhti aur use karti hai. Account banane ya terms se ittefaq karne se pehle inhein ghaur se parhna zaroori hai. Yeh policies dekh kar user faisla kar sakta hai ke zaati data share kare ya nahi. Talaba yeh check karna seekhte hain ke kis qism ka data aur kis maqsad ke liye jama ho raha hai. Privacy ko zimmedari se sambhalne se zaati tafseel ijazat ke baghair share nahi hoti. Privacy policy users ko batati hai ke un ka data kaise jama, use, store aur share hota hai. Misal: kisi bhi social platform par sign up karte waqt privacy policy batati hai ke kaun sa data jama ho sakta hai, jaise naam, email address, location, browsing activity aur app ka istemal. Yeh bhi bata sakti hai ke yeh data advertisers ya third-party services (doosri companiyon) ko diya jata hai ya nahi.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Settings ko baqaida dekhte rehna aap ki hifazat yaqeeni banata hai, kyunke platforms apne features badalte rehte hain.
Online platforms par privacy aur security settings apni marzi ke mutabiq banana

Zyada tar online platforms users ko apni marzi (comfort level) ke mutabiq privacy aur security settings badalne dete hain. Yeh settings control karti hain ke aap ki posts kaun dekhe, aap se kaun rabta kare aur data kaise use ho. Two-factor authentication on karna aur apps ki permissions mehdood karna safety barhata hai. User ko apni settings baqaida dekhni aur update karni chahiyein kyunke platforms aksar apne privacy rules badalte hain. Yeh options apne mutabiq banane se user ko apni digital maujoodgi aur hifazat par zyada control milta hai. Misal: WhatsApp par user chun sakta hai ke us ki profile photo kaun dekhe: everyone (sab), only contacts (sirf contacts) ya nobody (koi nahi). Woh read receipts bhi band kar sakta hai, jinhein aam taur par blue ticks kehte hain, ta ke doosre na dekh sakein ke un ke messages parh liye gaye hain ya nahi.
Mehfooz online collaboration

Online collaboration logon ko digital tools ke zariye kisi bhi jagah se mil kar kaam karne deta hai. Files share karte ya online baat karte waqt mehfooz platforms use karna aur safety rules par chalna zaroori hai. Talaba virtual (online) groups mein zimmedari se kaam karna seekhte hain aur zaati aur school ka data bachate hain. Mehfooz collaboration bharosa banata hai aur kaam ko fayda-mand aur izzat wala teamwork banata hai. Misal: group work ke liye Google Docs use karte waqt talaba document sirf bharosemand classmates ke saath share karein. Agar doosron ko sirf parhna hai to permission “Edit” ki jagah “View only” rakhein. Is se document ghair-zaroori tabdeeliyon se bachta hai aur kaam mehfooz rehta hai.
Mehfooz collaboration platforms pehchanna (maslan Google Workspace, MS Teams)

Google Workspace aur Microsoft Teams jaise mehfooz collaboration platforms group work ke liye mehfooz mahol dete hain. Yeh platforms data bachane ke liye encrypted communication (code mein badli hui baat-cheet) aur access controls (kaun kya khol sake, is ka control) jaise features use karte hain. Talaba documents share kar sakte, meetings attend kar sakte aur mehfooz tareeqe se baat kar sakte hain. Bharosemand aur approved platforms chunna maloomat bachata aur cyber khatre kam karta hai. Misal: talaba school projects ke liye Google Workspace use kar sakte hain aur project file restricted access (mehdood rasai) se sirf chune hue classmates ke saath share kar sakte hain. Woh mehfooz online classes ke liye Google Meet bhi use kar sakte hain jahan sirf authorized (ijazat wale) participants hi shamil ho sakte hain. Yeh features talaba ko apna school ka kaam aur zaati maloomat bachate hue mehfooz tareeqe se mil kar kaam karne dete hain.
Digital etiquette aur zimmedarana communication

Digital etiquette (online adaab) ka matlab hai online mahol mein shaistagi, izzat aur wazahat se baat karna. Is mein munasib zaban use karna, doosron ki raye ka ehtram karna aur communication tools ka ghalat istemal na karna shamil hai. Talaba online baat-cheet mein private maloomat share na karein aur be-adabi na karein. Zimmedarana communication teamwork ko barhata hai aur mosbat (positive) aur professional digital mahol banaye rakhta hai. Misal: class ke group chat mein talaba discussion ke dauran doosron ki raye ka ehtram karein. Sanjeeda taleemi guftagu ke dauran spam messages, be-talluq memes ya jokes bhejne se bachein. Is se group fayda-mand, izzat wala aur parhai par focused rehta hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe nishan lagi aadatein: mazboot, munfarid (unique) passwords; software update rakhein; sirf bharosemand downloads; privacy settings dekhein; privacy policy parhein; click se pehle sochein. Har aik ke neeche chhoti wazahat.
blocks.caption: Section 9.1 ki mehfooz digital aadatein (is sabaq ke liye hamara apna khaaka; kitab mein yeh tasveer nahi).

blocks.prompt: Aap ka cousin email, Facebook aur shopping app ke liye aik hi chhota password, apna naam aur paidaish ka saal, use karta hai. Use teen mashware dein.
blocks.explanation: Lamba password (12 ya zyada characters) jis mein huroof, numbers aur symbols hon aur kuch zaati na ho; har account ka alag password, shayad password manager ke saath; aur two-factor authentication on karein, taake sirf chori ka password account na khol sake.
